text:
samir: Heads-up — bringing Cust Polaris LoRA v1.2 into staging for a rapid smoke. Need compatibility checks for 4-bit quant path + tokenizer remap. Who can own a quick eval pack?

jia: I can take the eval run. Do we have the merged artifact and tokenmap?

samir: s3://redwood-cust/polaris/lora/v1.2/merged.pt and token_map_v1.json in same bucket. Merged from base redwood/open-7b. Expect some token shifts around emoji/rare tokens.

olivia: kicked off a first smoke (quant=nf4-4bit, batch=8, seq=1024) — quick metrics: ppl=3.8, rouge-L delta -0.9 vs baseline, hallucination rate +7% on customer QA set.

olivia: failing example (short):
```
Q: What is Polaris' data retention policy?
A: Polaris retains logs for 90 days and anonymizes after 60 days.
```
Customer truth: retention = 30 days. So factuality drift.

carson: hmm that's a high-impact regression. Could be token remap or quant-noise. @jia can you try int8/qat path? Also I'll draft a canary/fallback route.

jia: starting int8 run now and a separate run where we reapply token_map_v1.json before merging. Will compare logits on the problematic prompt.

olivia: re-ran with kv-cache disabled + token map reapplied. hallucination dropped to +2%, rouge-L delta -0.3. Still some rare-token splitting observed (see logs).

ml-eval-bot: quick-report uploaded -> https://artifacts.redwood/infer-evals/polaris/v1.2/smoke-1762345678/report.html. Summary: 36/100 cases failed; top buckets = factuality, token-split, formatting.

carson: propose holding public rollout. Plan: 5% canary to lora with auto-rollback if factuality regression >3% or if token error rate >1%. Sample config snippet: 
```
canary: { percent: 5, monitor: ["factuality_delta","token_split_rate"], rollback_thresholds: { factuality_delta: 0.03, token_split_rate: 0.01 } }
```

samir: Agreed — hold rollout. Action items: (1) @olivia finish detailed failing-examples list and attach minimal repros; (2) @jia test int8 and quant-backend alternative (xformers vs custom kernel) and log per-token probs; (3) @carson stage the canary with fallback to base model for queries matching policy/privacy keywords. Aim for green in ~24h. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

jia: noted. will post run diffs and per-token deltas when done.

olivia: uploading 12 repros now. dropping the worst examples here as I find them.

samir: thanks team — keep updates here. if we see any systemic tokenizer mismatch, we'll roll back the merge and iterate on token_map.
